overview: The Commission approved several demolition applications and scheduled significance hearings for the following month. Members also reviewed an archaeological survey for Brooks Estate and received updates on the restoration of Cross Street Cemetery.

items.title: 15 Maple Park Avenue
items.summary: Approved the demolition application for the Hedgner Center, which will proceed directly to a public hearing based on a prior determination of significance.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Applications
items.summary: Approved demolition applications for 67, 71, 73, and 81 Mystic Avenue, with determinations of significance for each property scheduled for the next meeting.

items.title: Spring Street, Surry Street, and Circuit Road
items.summary: Approved demolition applications for 146 Spring Street, 73 Surry Street, and 78 Circuit Road after confirming the applications were complete.

items.title: Zoning and High School Updates
items.summary: Received updates regarding a delay in the Boston Avenue zoning text and the ongoing search for historical records for the Medford High School Section 106 review.

items.title: Surveys and Cemetery Restoration
items.summary: Reviewed an archaeological survey of the Brooks Estate identifying sensitive areas and monitored progress on the Cross Street Cemetery restoration, including gravestone cleaning and radar bidding.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes and discussed the necessity of holding multiple meetings in October to accommodate a backlog of seven significance hearings.
